name: Seitan Burger
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 cup gluten flour (see seitan for how to gain gluten from wheat flour)

steps: Combine the water and gluten mixtures. Knead until smooth.
If using, knead in chopped onions.
Shape the seitan dough into patties.
Combine all the ingredients for the breading, and use it to coat the patties on all sides.
Fry the patties in an oiled pan. Don't use too much oil but enough to let the breading pick up some oil on both sides.
